ziel: Is it worth starting part-time with €5,000?
gegenstand: I want to sell my handmade mugs and bowls online. Budget €5,000, 6 months, part-time next to my job.

gespraech.text: Handmade ceramics, €5,000, part-time. Mia, would you buy?
Yes, if I see the mug in real daylight and know who made it. €35 is fine, €12 shipping is not.
That is the strength: a story and a face. Instagram plus Etsy first, own shop later.
Material, kiln, packaging, Etsy fees: about €14 per mug. At €35 you keep €21. 30 mugs a month covers costs, it is not a salary.
Assume it failed after 12 months. Breakage in shipping ate the margin, and you burned out making 30 mugs a month next to your job.
Breakage is solvable with tested packaging. Burnout is the real risk, I agree.
Nobody asked about the kiln: can you even produce 30 a month at home, and is it allowed in your flat?

fazit.note_fuer: Chance of a profitable side business in 12 months
fazit.begruendung: Real demand for handmade pieces with a story, but thin margins and limited production time.

kritikpunkte.text: Production capacity and kiln at home are unclear
Shipping cost and breakage can eat the margin
Own shop too early; marketplaces first

verbesserungen.nachher: Sell 20 pieces on Etsy within 6 weeks before spending more than €500.
Ship 5 test parcels to friends and count the breakage.

fazit.wichtigste_bedingung: You can produce 30 pieces a month without burning out.
fazit.naechster_schritt: Open an Etsy shop with 10 pieces and track sales for 6 weeks.
